title: Merc 1844 FUPS hi-tensile Bullbar #14
description: Actros 1844 FUPS high tensile aluminium Bullbar. 76mm (88mm option) one piece cross tubes through drilled uprights. Contoured main channel, provision available for radar. Tow pin and heavy duty steel backing plate, optional hi-tensile aluminium backing plate (save 83kg). Front mudflap mounts. Maximum protection for the long run. Factory fitted indicator repeater /clearance lights to outer channel return. Additional flush mounted indicator repeaters to main bar. Provision for factory fitted radar. Optional poly-carbonate headlight covers.
